claim: UT Dallas UEMR EMT course: students are released to self-schedule clinicals via an app after the Airway, Medical and Trauma lectures if grade is above 70; clinicals are three 12-hour ED shifts plus one 12-hour local fire department rotation.
quote: You will complete three 12 hour Emergency Department Clinicals and one 12-hour clinical rotation with a local fire department.
title: EMT Class FAQ - UEMR, UTD Police

claim: UT Dallas EMT course positions itself as catering to college undergraduates; formats are Hybrid (10-15 h/week online plus in-person lab) or Academy (Mon-Fri 8:30-4:30). No price and no explicit public-eligibility statement on the FAQ page.
quote: Our program is one of the only programs in North Texas that caters specifically to college undergraduate students.
title: EMT Class FAQ - UEMR, UTD Police

claim: UT Dallas FAQ says non-UTD programs may have clinical rotations of a lower standard than UTD's (self-reported comparison).
quote: you may find that the clinical rotations are a lower standard than our clinical relationships.
title: EMT Class FAQ - UEMR, UTD Police

claim: National EMS Academy Dallas (Fairview, TX): 12-week EMT, tuition $1,200, next class January 11, 2027; the page states no clinical hours, no clinical sites and no Acadian clinical arrangement.

title: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) - TCC
